title: Carney seems “quite dug in”
summary: President Trump upped the trade war with Canada by introducing tariffs that will go into effect next week. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Mark Carney has been building warm relationships around the globe. Scott Galloway and Jessica Tarlov discuss, on Raging Moderates.
